descriptions.core: Emberfall is an action-adventure RPG about a young firekeeper crossing a ruined kingdom to restore ancient beacons and uncover the truth behind the fall of her homeland.

features: Explore a ruined fantasy kingdom connected by ancient beacon routes.
Master fire-based combat abilities and combine them with environmental interactions.
Restore ancient beacons to unlock new regions and fast-travel routes.
Discover hidden lore through optional ruins, journals and environmental storytelling.
Customize abilities through a flexible skill system.

history_and_inspiration.history: Emberfall began as a small prototype focused on fire-based exploration mechanics before expanding into a full action-adventure RPG.
history_and_inspiration.inspiration: The team drew inspiration from illustrated fantasy novels, ruined medieval architecture and the feeling of exploring abandoned places.

quote.text: We wanted every ember in Emberfall to feel like a small piece of hope in a world that has almost forgotten how to survive.
quote.attribution: Maya Rao, Creative Director, Northstar Forge
